draft.answer: The mean concentration in the last third of sampled years (2010-2012) is about 10.34 times higher than in the first third (2001-2003). However, this cannot be read as a clear rise in Pacific plastic because the sampling locations shifted substantially (centroid shift of ~1042 km) between periods, confounding temporal trend with spatial variation.
